description: MemoryBackend.query_changes (common/mod.rs line 520) accepts filter, sort, max_changes, up_to_id, collapse_threads but binds all of them to _ (ignored). Returns only 'all ids added when sinceQueryState==0'. Tests that call Email/queryChanges or Mailbox/queryChanges against MemoryBackend never exercise these parameters. Maintenance consequence: a backend implementor using MemoryBackend tests as a correctness reference gets false confidence; real backends that ignore these params have no test coverage signal from this suite.
title: MemoryBackend query_changes silently ignores all filter/sort params
